rationale: The registry and Lang publication refer to one trial. The original reports inconclusive insomnia severity (interaction p=.3) and different results on sleep quality and objective latency.
PHQ-9 change is registered as a secondary outcome. The publication gives PHQ-9 at baseline, with no follow-up depression estimate.
The pooled insomnia contrast spans zero and combines distinct routes and preparations. The underlying trial cohorts are the evidence units.
Weak against recommendation for chronic insomnia in a general clinical population. The cited saffron trial is already included in earlier evidence and contributes no new cohort to this guideline.
The report describes initial longer sleep and a later difficult night in the context of coexposures. The copied posts count as one account.
The opening report describes worsening night waking and recurrence after resumption. Replies include different trajectories and products.
